text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "It was a TOTAL blast!! Yaay!!"

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
"Yaaaaay!"
"Y-Yay...!"
"A-And me too? ...Y-Yay."

The 2nd "Ramen Jamboree" was a huge success!
Every single customer was smiling!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Even you, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, but really, it's all thanks to you Trainers.
Thank you so much for all the prep work.
choice_data_list: Rather than me, go show some appreciation to Hello-san!
Don't worry about me, go take care of Hello-san!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
No, what I did was nothing special!
I only lent everyone a hand, really!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
All I did was handle the minor details of running the event...
This result is solely thanks to all the hard work put in by you and the others, Fine!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: So, it is all of you who should truly be proud of this success!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Once again, great work, everyone!
Yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
“—That may be what was said, but the only reason
we can hold this event at all is thanks to the hard work
of Hello-san and everyone else, so...”

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? Shall we...
express our gratitude to everyone somehow?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: However, I'd prefer if you didn't get carried away.
choice_data_list: Even though you're the one who took the lead on this?!
Even though you're the one who took the lead on this?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we can't get ahead of ourselves...
Running out of toppings, managing the lines... it's our second time.
We should have cut down on those mistakes more.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for being so ill-prepared!
Next time, I'll make sure everything is in perfect order...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
N-No, Hello-san has been doing great!
We're the ones who need to reflect on ourselves—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
No, if I had listened to you more closely,
maybe we could have prevented this... Yeah.
Please let me hear your thoughts again for next time!
choice_data_list: I'll join you as well. Let's come up with a plan together!
I'll join you as well. Let's figure out a plan together!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ms. Hello and the others are working so hard... for the sake of the event, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
So, what do you say? Shall we find a way
to express our gratitude to them...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great!
But how should I express my gratitude...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. What else could it be other than something
that starts with 'ra' and ends with 'men'?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
However, umm... you always taste-test
my ramen, so...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, true! In that case, maybe just treating
them to ramen won't be enough to please them?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Then how about something like this?
What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The flavor soaked in too much, so it
didn't quite fit as a topping anymore, but here's some chashu pork...

text_block_list.name: Fine & Top Road
text_block_list.text: Th-This is it~!!

One day, Light Hello and I were both
called over by Fine Motion and the others.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Today, we've prepared a small token of gratitude for everyone who supports our efforts to give back!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Please, try some!
It's a snack we came up with!

text_block_list.name: Hello & Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
"Yay! It's so yummy!"
"Mmm! It really is delicious!"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"Are these deep-fried pasta snacks made from Chinese noodles?
The saltiness is just perfect, I can't stop munching on them!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Boiled eggs marinated in tonkotsu ramen broth
are delicious too! The flavor soaks all the way through!
choice_data_list: ...Uh oh, feels like I could keep eating forever!
...Oh dear, I feel like I could eat endlessly!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I've prepared some extra for you to take home as a souvenir! Please eat lots at home too!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Wah! I... I haven't done anything
to deserve something like this!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
N-N-N-No way, that's not true at all!!
I mean, the event was a total success this time too!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Is that because Hello-san... because all of you supported me behind the scenes...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...That is why.
Please, accept this.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
“Still, the reason we can do our best—
is because we've seen all of you giving it your all.”

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Traveling around the country for the fans... and researching ramen between her studies and races—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Hearing something like that, wouldn't anyone want to support them?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
So, it's not like I was looking for gratitude
or anything, but... hehe.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Putting that aside, I'm delighted! Truly!
I'll be sure to put these snacks to good use!
